I had an excellent experience at the hospital from start to finish. I was warmly greeted and assisted right away, and the entire process was smooth and efficient. Scheduling and facilitating my appointment was incredibly easy.

The hospital was very clean, and the staff were supportive and professional throughout my visit, which made the whole health check experience even better. I especially appreciated that they arranged a taxi for me before I left it was a thoughtful and convenient touch.

I would highly recommend this hospital. Truly an amazing experience.

Mission Hospital is a highly reputable and trustworthy healthcare facility. The hospital provides excellent medical services and maintains clean, modern, and well-equipped facilities. The doctors are professional, knowledgeable, and attentive to patients’ needs, while the nurses and staff are friendly, supportive, and always willing to help.

From registration to treatment, the entire process is smooth and well-organized, making patients feel comfortable and well cared for. I truly appreciate the dedication and compassion shown by the whole team. I highly recommend Mission Hospital to anyone looking for quality medical care.

I would like to share my positive experience with the hospital. The level of care and service was truly excellent — I felt well looked after throughout my stay.

The room was clean, comfortable, and created a very pleasant environment for recovery. The doctor, Arkorn Rotjanawipat, demonstrated a high level of professionalism and expertise, and the surgery was performed successfully.

I would also like to especially highlight the attentive and caring attitude of the coordinator, Kiti, who provided great support and assistance.

Overall, everything went smoothly, and I am very satisfied with the service I received.

Just had my check-up after my holiday injury, and I honestly couldn’t be more grateful.

From the staff to the nurses and doctor — everyone was incredibly kind, professional, and efficient. Everything was handled so smoothly, and I walked out feeling relieved, cared for, and genuinely happy.

They even wished me good luck and a speedy recovery 🥹

If you’re a tourist in Bangkok and ever need medical attention, I can truly recommend this place. You’ll be in very good hands.

Im a foreigner from England and came in at 4 in the morning with tonscillitus on my first day in Thailand.
It took a little while to get a room but that was mainly due to issues with money on my end rather than the hospital.

Would recommend

Highly recommended — Mission Hospital truly delivers excellent care.

I’m a foreigner traveling in Thailand when I suddenly experienced severe abdominal pain and had to go to Mission Hospital in Bangkok. It turned out to be appendicitis, and I needed emergency surgery. I was fortunate to be treated by Dr. Nateepat , who provided clear and professional explanations that made me feel confident and at ease before the operation. His calm demeanor and thorough guidance helped ease my anxiety significantly. The cost of the surgery and hospital stay was also very reasonable, especially when compared to other private hospitals in Bangkok.
I highly recommend this hospital to any foreigner seeking quality surgical care at an affordable price. The surgery went very well, and I received excellent care from both the doctor and all the hospital staff throughout my stay. I was especially impressed by Dr. Nateepat. Despite his youthful appearance, he showed remarkable surgical skill and professionalism, as though he had performed this procedure countless times. The incision from my appendectomy was incredibly small and neat something I truly appreciated. If you ever need surgery and have the chance to be under his care, you won’t be disappointed. I’m deeply grateful and genuinely impressed by the experience.

I'm not sure if this review sounds exaggerated, but I'm a recent graduate from a provincial town working in Bangkok. Choosing a hospital to use my social security benefits was very difficult, but the reviews looked good, so I decided to give it a try. Then, when I actually got sick and had the opportunity to use their services, it made me, a single person from the province, feel good and safe knowing I could at least have a hospital like this when I was ill. Everyone, from the entrance to the doctors, was incredibly kind to me. I especially appreciated that no one was rude or disrespectful, even when I asked questions; they were a bit clueless at times. I was very impressed by their politeness. Plus, the waiting area had comfortable chairs, and the wait times were much shorter than at other hospitals I've been to. Thank you to everyone who works here. I hope they maintain this standard of service and treatment. Thank you.
